utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—what’s the time and place? I might have a lamp that’s been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by late and help with whatever’s still left—sorting supplies or the last deliveries both work for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really kind of you, Dane. If you’re able to come late, I can pass that along—people around here would appreciate the extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning still works for me. Just let me know the first tasks, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — could you check the donation table by the entrance first and tell me what’s there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the donation table by the entrance and let you know what’s there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — just swing by if you need any extra tools or a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Noah — happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — remind me what still needs doing, and I’ll tackle the first one I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll remind everyone about the repair drive and send you the list of what still needs doing, with the weekend as our target.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. Send me the list when you can, and I’ll jump on the first repair.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira — if you can send me a quick list of needed tools and spare parts, I’ll compare it with what we already have and note what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re saying you want me to send a quick list of needed tools and spare parts, right? I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, exactly — send me the list when you can, and I’ll compare it with our supplies and note what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word to everyone I can about the repair drive. If you’re free, you should definitely stop by—it’d be great to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still in — I heard a few folks are bringing tools and supplies, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear—thanks for spreading the word too. I’ll keep letting everyone know, and I’m glad we’re getting such a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken fence by the playground, then the leaking sink and the sidewalk step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—could you let me know where and when the drop-offs are happening? I want to make sure I can get there without any hassle.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Drop-offs are at the community hall parking lot, Saturday 9–11 AM.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — the repair drive is at the community center, and I can keep an eye on the donation table by the entrance. If your lamp’s acting up, bring it along and we’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’ll check what’s needed at the community center and bring the lamp along if I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll be at the entrance table, so just bring it by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — let’s start with the most urgent fixes and then I’ll line up the tools and volunteers after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and help keep the word going.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep organizing the urgent fixes, and once we have more folks, we can match everyone to the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can do that — I’ll ask around and bring you the where and when as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Tess. I appreciate you checking around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I’ve got the where and when.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, we’re still on for this weekend. I’ll bring the short list by tomorrow so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—just bring the short list tomorrow and I’ll help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—send the repair drive details when you can, and I’ll bring whatever tools I’ve got handy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll send them over soon. If you can, please bring any basic tools and I’ll point you to the donation table at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the basics and head to the donation table at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and as soon as I hear the first tasks, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely helping spread the word, right? If so, please send me the first tasks as soon as you get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, definitely—I’m spreading the word now, and I’ll send you the first tasks as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in — I heard a few folks are bringing tools and supplies, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that’s good to hear — we still need a few small repairs sorted, and I was hoping to have everything wrapped up by the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds doable — if more folks keep pitching in, I think we can get those small repairs wrapped up by the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a short list and drop it by tomorrow so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing—I can mention it to a few folks I know too. Just let me know if there’s anything else you need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep it simple for now and bring the list by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to be sure, what part of the repair drive do you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help with coordinating the timing and letting parents know the details? I’m trying to make sure it fits around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I can help with the timing and parent updates. I’ll check the schedule and get the details sorted around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mainly been hearing about the drop-off stuff, but I can pass along whatever else you need. Do they still want tools, or is it mostly donations now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly donations, I think — but if they still want tools, I can bring a few handy ones too. Just send me the details and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the exact details and pass them along. Sounds like donations are the main thing for now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center—bring the lamp by and we’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I can swing by late if I’m needed and help with whatever’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be awesome, Dane—late help would be really appreciated if there’s still a pile left.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I can bring a few spare parts. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah—if you can, please tell me when and where you’ll be dropping them off so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I can drop them off tomorrow afternoon by the community shed. I’ll let you know if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the donation table by the entrance, if that helps. Just let me know what you want me to watch for.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — please watch for donations and note anything that’s especially useful for the fence, sink, or sidewalk step. I’ll sort the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note anything useful for the fence, sink, or sidewalk step and keep track of the donation table by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Quinn. I’ll try to come by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help—if you need me, I can handle setup or collecting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really kind of you, Sam. I’ll let you know if I can make it and what would help most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming along nicely, and folks have already started dropping things off. I can go ask around and bring you the where and when as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d be great—thanks. Just let me know if they still need tools, cash, or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and let you know what they still need. If I hear where and when the drop-offs are, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—remind me which repairs are still left, and I’ll see what I can take on first. I’ll do my best to have it done by the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I can pull together the current list of needed tools and spare parts, then we can match that up with the remaining repairs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be perfect, Cleo—send me the list and I’ll pick a couple I can handle. If anything needs a bit of extra help, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mara — I can help out with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need and swing by anytime.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll check in as soon as I know the first tasks and what tools will be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll have the tools ready.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
